plugins.name: steve-designer
plugins.description: Agentic design director that owns the UI design system of any project, across three modes: Creation (discovery, reference synthesis, tokens, build, polish — delegating execution to frontend-design, ui-ux-pro-max, Playwright, baseline-ui, and the accessibility/motion polish pipeline), Governance (adopts and enforces an existing design system with a mechanical + semantic gate), and Direction (builds or hands off every subsequent UI change, then verifies it).
